claims.verbatim:
Steamship Royal Standard (Br), Whineray, Liverpool May

Saml Thompson's Nephew. June 1, lat 46 01, lon 33 46,
passed a steamer, schooner rigged, with red funnel, steering
eastward; 2d, lat 44 02, lon 40 35[?], ship Webster, from Liver-
pool for New York, 14 days out; 3d, lat 44 02[?], lon 48 20, bark
Mary Ann Addison (Br), steering W; 7th, lat 41 50, lon 61 32,
steamship Asia; 9th, ship Antarctic, from Liverpool for New
York.

claims.verbatim:
Steamship Royal Standard (Br.), Whineray, Liverpool May 23, and
Queenstown 25th, with mdse. and 310 pass. to Samuel Thompson's
Nephew. June 1, lat. 46 01, long. 33 46, passed a steamer, schooner-
rigged, with red funnel, steering E; June 2, lat. 44 02, long. 40 35,
passed ship Webster, from Liverpool to New-York, 14 days out; June
3, lat. 44 02[?], long. 48 30[?], passed British bark Mary Ann Addison, steer-
ing W; June 7, lat. 41 59[?], long. 61 32[?], passed steamship Asia; June 9,
passed ship Antarctic, from Liverpool for New-York.
